blocks.text: Tkinter bohat se components deta hai jinhein widgets kehte hain; in se interactive graphical applications banti hain. Aik program mein kai visual cheezein ho sakti hain, jaise windows, frames, buttons aur text fields. Widgets se user data likhta, options chunta ya koi kaam karta hai. Har widget ka apna maqsad hai, aur inhein mila kar poora interface banta hai. Tkinter layout management bhi deta hai taake widgets screen par saleeqe se rakhe ja sakein.

blocks.title: Class Activity
blocks.text: Aik main window banayein aur use do frames mein baantein. Layout munazzam karne ke liye har frame mein alag widgets dalein.

items: Widgets: window, frame, button, text field jaise hisse jin se interface banta hai.
Har widget ka apna kaam; layout management unhein saleeqe se rakhti hai.
